title: Approval and generation
rules: Ask for explicit user approval of only the current stage.
Never send approval fields before the user approves.
Never inline generated artifact bodies when review paths are available.

sections.heading: Stage
sections.body: Review the packet's current decision.stage and artifact review paths. After explicit approval, call the same workflow with `approval: {session_id, stage, approved_stages}`.

sections.heading: Execute
sections.body: When no approval stage remains, call the workflow with `execute:true` and `approval: {session_id, approved_stages, complete:true}`.
